title: Review: fix review findings KITH-92gt (P2/P3/P4)
notes:
contact.rs review: 4 findings. Confidence: 90%. P1: newState is set to current store state after maxChanges truncation — paging clients will drop changes silently. P2: test_contact_changes_max_changes_truncation does not assert newState value so the P1 bug has no test coverage. P2: unknown patch key error type is invalidArguments but RFC 8620 §5.3 requires invalidProperties for per-object set errors. P3 (maintainer): KNOWN_UPDATE_KEYS is inside process_update function body, not co-located with the Contact struct definition in kith-store.
kith-peer review: 2 findings. Confidence: 95%.
tls/discovery review: 5 findings. Confidence: 90%. Issues: KITH-ygr0.3 (wrong error variant), KITH-ygr0.5 (missing symmetric partial-presence test), KITH-ygr0.10 (double-bracket bug for pre-bracketed IPv6 input), KITH-ygr0.11 (missing test for pre-bracketed IPv6), KITH-ygr0.12 (cert written before key — inconsistent state on key-write failure). No issues with OnceLock init, build_probe_client retained correctly, error message quality adequate, IPv4/IPv6 bracketing logic correct for non-pre-bracketed input.
